{{Quote|We had hoped to bring in new recruits to the Imperial Navy but we fear that the Rebels have followed our idea. Now, we have to compete for new recruits.|Recruiting Officer Limna Renence|<ref name="SWG:IDN" />}}
'''Limna Renence''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Renence was a [[Recruitment officer/Legends|recruiting officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy Recruitment|recruitment office]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Limna Renence was involved in a large recruitment program of new [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Imperial Starfighter Corps]]. Although the Imperial Navy recruitment program was a success, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and neutral factions soon initiated similar programs that were also very successful.<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Limna Renence was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IDN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The document mentioning Limna Renence was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:IDN" />
